steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: 1944 Education Act: introduced the tripartite system - grammar schools (academic, 20% via 11+ exam), secondary moderns (practical/vocational, 75%), technical schools (few existed). Supposedly meritocratic but reproduced class inequality - middle-class children disproportionately passed the 11+. | Key Fact: 1965: comprehensive education replaced the tripartite system. All pupils attend the same type of school regardless of ability. Aimed to reduce inequality and create social mixing. Evaluation: reduced the stigma of failing the 11+ but streaming within comprehensives reproduced inequality.
